aspect: It is never decided, only assumed
description: No conversation allocates it. It accretes, and by the time it is visible it is established.
energy_note: Nobody asked her. It simply became hers.

aspect: The cost is measured in her pension
description: Reduced hours, declined promotions and years out produce a retirement income gap that arrives thirty years later.

aspect: The brother who visits is praised
description: Occasional involvement from a sibling attracts gratitude that continuous provision does not.
energy_note: He comes at Christmas and everyone says how good he is.

description: 'You're the one with the flexible job.' She is a district nurse. Her brother is a project manager who works from home three days a week.
